func (ObservationOutcome) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)

func ObservationOutcomeValues() []ObservationOutcome
func (ObservationOutcome) Known() bool

type ServiceErrorCode string
const ServiceErrorCodeHandlerError

var Operations
var RefusalCodes
var ResourceActions
type Question struct
  Asker string
  Key string
  Slots map[string]string
type Request struct
  Op string
  Ask *Question
  Wait bool
  ID string
  Option string
  Admin string
type Answer struct
  ID string
  Pending bool
  Option string
  Yes bool
  Kept bool
type RecordMetadata struct
  ID string
  Asker string
  Key string
  About string
  Text string
  Options []string
  Asked string
  Option string
  Answered string
  Kept bool
  Yes bool
type ResponseMetadata struct
  Code string
  Error string
  Answer *Answer
  Records []RecordMetadata
type ApplicationQuestion struct
  RequestKey string
  Key string
  Slots map[string]string
type QuestionObservation struct
  Outcome ObservationOutcome
  Answer *Answer
type OperatorPage struct
  Outcome OperatorPageOutcome
  Records []RecordMetadata
  Next string
  Complete bool
type OperatorDecision struct
  Outcome OperatorDecisionOutcome
  Record *RecordMetadata
type OperatorRetirement struct
  Outcome OperatorRetirementOutcome
  Record *RecordMetadata
func Encode(v *Request) []byte
type Refusal struct
  Word string
  Offset int
func (Refusal) Error() string
func Decode(in []byte) (*Request, error)
type FrameWriter interface
  WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
type DispatchError string
func (DispatchError) Error() string
func ServiceName(frame []byte) (string, error)
type FrameExchanger interface
  ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type ServiceError struct
  Code ServiceErrorCode
  Message string
func (ServiceError) Error() string
const EndpointContract
type DescribedService interface
  DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func DescribeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...DescribedService) ([]byte, error)
type ServedService interface
  DescribedService
  ServiceContract() string
func ServeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...ServedService) ([]byte, error)
type QuestionApplication interface
  Ask(question ApplicationQuestion) (QuestionObservation, error)
  Observe(requestKey string, waitMs int64) (QuestionObservation, error)
type QuestionApplicationTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type QuestionApplicationClient struct
func NewQuestionApplicationClient(t QuestionApplicationTransport) *QuestionApplicationClient
type QuestionApplicationDispatcher struct
  Handler QuestionApplication
func (QuestionApplicationClient) Ask(question ApplicationQuestion) (result QuestionObservation, err error)
func (QuestionApplicationClient) Observe(requestKey string, waitMs int64) (result QuestionObservation, err error)
func (QuestionApplicationDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (QuestionApplicationDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (QuestionApplicationDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (QuestionApplicationDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type QuestionOperator interface
  ListQuestions(cursor string, limit int64) (OperatorPage, error)
  AnswerQuestion(id, option string) (OperatorDecision, error)
  RetireQuestion(id string) (OperatorRetirement, error)
type QuestionOperatorTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type QuestionOperatorClient struct
func NewQuestionOperatorClient(t QuestionOperatorTransport) *QuestionOperatorClient
type QuestionOperatorDispatcher struct
  Handler QuestionOperator
func (QuestionOperatorClient) ListQuestions(cursor string, limit int64) (result OperatorPage, err error)
func (QuestionOperatorClient) AnswerQuestion(id, option string) (result OperatorDecision, err error)
func (QuestionOperatorClient) RetireQuestion(id string) (result OperatorRetirement, err error)
func (QuestionOperatorDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (QuestionOperatorDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (QuestionOperatorDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (QuestionOperatorDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
